title: Anatomy of the P vs. NP Barrier: Zero-Mathlib Lean 4 Formalization of Classical Obstructions, Exact SAT Multiplicative Complexity, and Four Algorithmic Falsifiers
description: Machine-checks 25 zero-Mathlib Lean 4.35.0 declarations (14 statements C1-C14 (the Baker-Gill-Solovay theorem, the counting step of natural proofs, and twelve classical supporting lemmas) + prove_all + 5 concrete NonVacuity witnesses NV1-NV5 + 5 AdversarialTests sharpness refutations ADV1-ADV5, with 15 isolated Palomar Challenge/Solution comparator targets and a negative elaboration test in CI (a false statement must fail to compile)): Baker-Gill-Solovay relativization (C1-C2), the counting step of the natural-proofs argument, a telescoping bound and a largeness witness (C3-C5), minimal unsatisfiability of odd-cycle and Mermin-Peres XOR systems (C6-C7), polymorphism facts and projection-only rigidity of {x∨y∨z, ¬x∨¬y∨¬z} (C8-C9), Markov's negation bound and a k-NOT compilation without size bound (C10-C11), AND-count versus F2-degree (C12), permanent = determinant mod 2 (C13), and reversible register programs (C14). Paired with exact CaDiCaL 2.1.2 SAT multiplicative-complexity synthesis cross-checked by exhaustive brute-force enumeration, three exact counterexamples and one numerical illustration against four illustrative SAT heuristics (CTDS ODE blowup, rational LP integrality gaps, 3-adic Hensel non-Boolean root, completely rigid |Aut|=1 3-SAT instance), 27 references (three DOIs in the repository's citation audit resolve to unrelated records; correction pending), DigiCert RFC 3161 TSA timestamp (data/MANIFEST.sha256.tsr) over LF-normalized 21-artifact MANIFEST.sha256, 0 ruff / 0 mypy errors, 12/12 cross-OS pytest+Hypothesis tests, 15-page zero-overfull AMS-LaTeX preprint + standalone arXiv tarball, interactive searchable WCAG 2.2 AA GitHub Pages Proof Blueprint, and 100.0% (63/63) Build Standard v1.2.0 compliance.
